feedback: `blocker_moved` is wrong: it returns true whenever the cell left/right-adjacent to any x holds no ball, but the intended semantics is that the specific cell in front of the (single) door holds no ball. The nested comprehension mixes scopes incorrectly (the outer `any` iterates over x,y with an extra `if` clause applied inside `any`'s generator over all x,y — actually the `if` filters the outermost loop, so the condition is not the specified 'cell in front of the door' check at all). The reference expression is simply `not any(c is not None and c.type == 'ball' for c in [env.grid.get(dx - 1, dy)])` where `(dx,dy)` is the door's cell; the candidate instead scans all cells adjacent to any door-free cell and can be true even when the ball still blocks the door, and does not become false again when the ball is dropped back on the blocking cell. Rewrite `blocker_moved` to first locate the door cell and then test the ball at `(dx - 1, dy)`.
